{{Quote|It was built by one of my predecessors&mdash;Moff Frisan, I think it was. I've only been inside twice. It's much larger than I expected: six rooms, laid out along the same lines as the palace residence suite, only with a food prep area and considerably more storage.|Governor Bidor Ferrouz, on Frisan's safe room|<ref name="Choices" />}}
'''Frisan''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who served as the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]], which included the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Poln Major]] and [[Poln Minor]]. They designed an [[Palace emergency safe room|emergency safe room]] underneath their [[Whitestone City palace|palace]] on Poln Major.<ref name="Choices" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> Frisan had been succeeded by Governor [[Bidor Ferrouz]]. [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] speculated that the Moff was fond of tunnels as their safe room contained several corridors and tunnels.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frisan was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
